en.headline: Seven firms win IP-backed loans in first sandbox batch
en.dek: Banks completed credit approval on seven pilot cases worth HK$1 million to HK$39 million, the Monetary Authority and government said.
body: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said on Wednesday that banks taking part in the intellectual property financing sandbox had completed credit approval for a first batch of seven pilot cases, with loan amounts ranging from HK$1 million to HK$39 million.

The government said the cases span electronics, construction, toy manufacturing and medical devices, and that the underlying assets include patents and trade marks. The loans are intended for working capital, expansion and marketing. Three major banks — Bank of China (Hong Kong), HSBC and Standard Chartered — joined the sandbox when it launched in December 2025 with the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau and the Intellectual Property Department.

The authorities said banks can take independent IP valuation reports into their credit assessments and, on that basis, offer larger facilities or more favourable rates to borrowers that are rich in intangible assets but light on conventional collateral.

A two-year patent valuation support scheme opened the same day. Eligible small and medium-sized firms can apply for a one-off matching grant of up to HK$80,000 to commission a valuation of patents and other IP. Firms that hold at least one Hong Kong patent that has passed substantive examination can also obtain a free quality analysis report on one designated patent.

zh.headline: 知識產權融資沙盒首批七宗個案獲批
zh.dek: 金管局公布參與銀行完成七宗試點審批，貸款由100萬至3,900萬元，涵蓋電子、建築、玩具及醫療器材。
body: 香港金融管理局星期三宣布，知識產權融資沙盒參與銀行已完成首批七宗試點個案的融資審批，貸款金額介乎100萬港元至3,900萬港元。
政府表示，個案涵蓋電子、建築、玩具製造及醫療器材等行業，涉及的知識產權包括專利和商標，資金用於日常營運、業務拓展及市場推廣。沙盒由商務及經濟發展局、金管局及知識產權署於2025年12月推出，中國銀行（香港）、滙豐及渣打率先參與。
當局指，銀行可把獨立估值報告納入信貸評估，按知識產權資產價值提高貸款額或給予較優惠利率，協助擁有無形資產但缺乏傳統抵押品的中小企融資。
同日推出為期兩年的專利估值先導支援計劃。合資格中小企可申請一次過上限8萬元的1比1配對資助，委託合資格估值機構為專利及其他知識產權估值。若企業持有至少一項已通過實質審查的香港專利，亦可獲免費專利質素分析報告。
